datasets.labelOrigin: Publisher GIS experts manually annotated SN2 scenes; second expert validated all areas; source reports approximate five-pixel corner tolerance, not survey truth

floor_plan.targetEncoding: uint8 PNG class IDs 0..11; 0 is publisher default background, not ignore
floor_plan.ignorePolicy: No added semantic ignore pixels; Undefined/UserDefined and unsupported room aliases use publisher other_room mapping; no independent ambiguity reannotation

sourcePixelTransform.frame: F1_scaled source pixels, top-left x/right y/down
sourcePixelTransform.svgToImage: Identity raw polygon coordinates as pinned FloorplanSVG.get_txt/House; do not scale to SVG viewBox

floor_plan.rasterization: Pinned rooms_selected aliases; numpy rint coordinates; publisher g order; Wall/Railing min extent <4 skipped; integer-grid polygon inclusion with boundary. 12 masks match scikit-image 0.25.2 _polygon pixel-for-pixel; no full House heatmap/icon parity claim
floor_plan.weakCoverage: garage class appears once, from publisher CarPort alias; bedroom in four images; no legal units/floor identity/metric area truth

building.targetEncoding: uint8 PNG 0/1; original GeoJSON preserves feature IDs and partial attributes
building.ignorePolicy: Score only scoringMask==1. All-zero RGB source pixels are conservatively ignored; GeoTIFF has no GDAL_NODATA tag, so this is an explicit analysis mask, not a publisher validity claim. Keep excluded-positive denominator

sourcePixelTransform.frame: 650x650 PS-RGB source pixels, top-left x/right y/down

building.rgbConversion: Original uncompressed uint16 PS-RGB: per-band p02/p98 over non-all-zero pixels; clip to [0,1], numpy rint(value*255), uint8 RGB; no resize/rotation. Per-item stretch values retained
building.rasterization: GeoJSON CRS84 lon/lat -> inverse source EPSG:4326 PixelIsArea affine -> source pixel centers (x+0.5,y+0.5), union polygon exteriors, subtract holes; include clipped partial buildings; no minimum-area filtering

excludedItems.reason: One publisher Point feature has no boundary: do not convert it to a mask or background truth

verification.sourceAndDerivativePins: All 20 raw image/label pairs plus eligible masks/input PNGs verified; 19 raster transfers match reference exactly
verification.previewScope: Agent sanity inspection of one multilevel plan and occupied building overlay; not new independent truth
